network.title: Network Access Information
network.subtitle: The following is the network configuration information for mobile access to local services
network.ipPlaceholder: Please enter local LAN IP, e.g., 192.168.1.100 (check with ipconfig / ifconfig)
network.invalidIpWarning: Please enter a valid IPv4 address
network.tipsTitle: Solutions for phone unable to access local service
network.tip1: Ensure same network: Phone and computer must be connected to the same WiFi / LAN
network.tip2: Disable firewall: Windows firewall may block LAN access, please temporarily disable or add port forwarding rule
network.tip3: Use LAN IP: Phone cannot access localhost, enter local LAN IP in the input box above (check with ipconfig / ifconfig command)
network.tip4: Check port: Confirm service is running on port {port} and not occupied
